integrity: The initiating Seshadri theorem, the affine E8^(1) Kac translation formula, and the Cremona-general-position realization were checked in their primary sources. The universal coefficient formula is proved symbolically; the included checker independently replays lattice identities and the integral inverse but is not used as a substitute for the geometric argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats one explicit affine-Weyl orbit on a very general nine-point plane blow-up. It does not classify all square-20 ample classes, all irrational Seshadri constants on the surface, or the exceptional locus of evaluation points.
title: An infinite fixed-square Weyl orbit of irrational Seshadri classes on \(X_9\)
